name: ops-tarot-app
description: iOS / Android app shell for Ops Tarot Studio (honeytime.life), built with Capacitor

scripts.ios: node scripts/setup.mjs ios && cap open ios
scripts.android: node scripts/setup.mjs android && cap open android
scripts.build:android: node scripts/setup.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:debug: node scripts/setup.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
